verdict.rationale: Algolia's Agent Studio is documented as connecting your chosen LLM to Algolia search and tools. It grounds responses in live data from your indices and supports conversational search, shopping assistants and content summarizers, with cached completions. The documented Search API, hybrid NeuralSearch and a Crawler skill that builds RAG-optimized indexes provide the retrieval layer. Missing for 10: no evidence of a documented Agent Studio/answer API reference (endpoints, streaming, citations), and no independent or hands-on corroboration of RAG/conversational use.
